text:
samira: Heads-up: Vendor-Sec confirmed an assessment next Thursday. Need to finalize the assessment playbook: RBAC window, KMS grant model, evidence manifest format, intake scrub rules, and retest SOPs. Looping @ben @kevin @nisha
ben: Staging-only, ephemeral SSO role for vendor, no service tokens. We should codify a short "conduct rules" section for the engagement (no data exfil, no production targeting).
kevin: Agreed. I'll create a session role pt-session-{eng} with an inline session policy limiting to the staging account and allow only read/list/describe for infra. KMS: I'll expose a data-key flow (GenerateDataKey + Decrypt) scoped to the PT CMK alias.
nisha: Audit asks: enable management + data events for the ingest prefix, route to SIEM, tag all events with pt_id, and keep retention 395 days. Also require object-level logs for S3 and any EBS snapshot ops.
samira: Evidence manifest: vendor must upload to s3://pt-manifests/{eng}/incoming/. Each upload must include x-amz-meta-sha256 and a small JSON manifest describing files. We'll require filename pattern: manifest-{eng}-{timestamp}.json.
vendor-sec: Quick Q: Do you accept compressed bundles (.tar.gz)? We may include multiple artifacts in one bundle.
ben: Yes, allowed. Max bundle 400MB single-part PUT. Require the manifest JSON listing each file name, size, and sha256. Example manifest fields: ["files":[{"name":"report.pdf","size":12345,"sha256":"..."}], "uploader":"vendor-sec", "pt_id":"ENG-7788"]
ingest-bot: [INFO] Presign service: enforce single-part PUT only, max 400MB, require x-amz-meta-sha256 and x-amz-meta-pt_id. Emit structured log JSON to /pt-presign (schema below).
kevin: Minimal KMS policy snippet we can share with vendor (paste to them):
```
{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-eng-2026"}]}
```
nisha: Add a PII-scrub step: ingestion lambda should run a lightweight scrub for obvious PII (emails, SSNs, credit card patterns) and redact before we index into vuln-tracker. If PII is detected, flag the object and require manual review before posting to the board.
samira: Good. Also add ObjectLock GOVERNANCE on locked prefix for 30d and require presigned uploads to set server-side encryption (AES256 or AWS-KMS).
vendor-sec: We can include checksums and manifest; do you have an example curl flow?
ben: Example: 
```
# get presign
curl -X POST 'https://ingest.redwood.internal/presign' -d '{"pt_id":"ENG-7788","name":"bundle.tar.gz"}' | jq -r .url
# upload
curl -H 'x-amz-meta-sha256: abcd1234...' -H 'x-amz-meta-pt_id: ENG-7788' -T bundle.tar.gz "<presigned-url>"
```
kevin: Intake mode: vendor may either POST findings via webhook (preferred) or upload a findings.json to the ingest prefix. Webhook payload will create a "PT Intake" card on vuln-tracker; we'll triage internally before opening remediation tickets. SLA proposal: ack within 24h, triage note within 48h, remediation ETA: 3 business days for critical.
samira: Retest policy: vendor can request a single retest within 14 business days after we mark fixes deployed. We'll offer two candidate windows: overnight (00:30-02:30 PT) or early morning (06:00-08:00 PT). Oncall confirm staffing. Post-retest we will rotate any KMS keys used and revoke sessions.
oncall: [BOT] PagerDuty stub created PD-PT-2026-ENG7788. I can cover the overnight slot.
kevin: One more: vendor asked about HSM. If regulator requires FIPS/HSM, we can provide an HSM-backed CMK, but lead time 48h. We'll note that in the handshake.
nisha: Action items (owner / due):
- kevin: create pt-session role + session policy JSON + KMS statement for vendor review (due: EOD)
- ben: publish manifest schema and example curl snippets in the internal handshake doc (due: EOD)
- ingestion: implement presign constraints + checksum validator + PII-scrub + ObjectLock move (owner: ingestion team, pinged) (due: EOD)
- nisha: enable CloudTrail/S3 data events + SIEM forward + retention tags (due: EOD)
samira: I'll send the vendor handshake email now with the ingest prefix, conduct rules, and retest slots -> https://docs.internal.redwood/pt-playbook-eng7788 (sending).
vendor-sec: Thanks, will review and confirm HSM needers by EOD.
kevin: ack
ben: ack
nisha: ack
oncall: ack
samira: Closing thread for now. Reopen if vendor requests cross-cloud upload or HSM immediately. Thanks everyone!
